key_facts: The A.V. Club, citing Business Insider's report of a Twitter event, says Elon Musk said he has had 'AI or SI psychosis' about half a dozen times this year.
Musk also said he has 'a little bit of cyber psychosis', adding 'maybe a lot actually'.
He then praised AI-generated music, saying calling it 'slop-core' is a misnomer and it is 'awesome-core'.
The piece quotes Futurism's description of AI psychosis, which it says is not a medically recognised condition.
The article is satirical commentary on Musk's remarks.
quote_evidence: "At various points this year," Musk said at a Twitter event, as reported by Business Insider, "I've had AI or SI psychosis probably like half a dozen times."
"Calling it slop-core is a misnomer. Frankly it's awesome-core."
why_it_matters_hint: Musk's own remark about AI-fuelled delusion, covered with heavy commentary.
notes: Heavily opinionated; unflattering personal claims about Musk in the article are not repeated. Original report is Business Insider's, not read.
title: Elon Musk admits he might be suffering from AI-delusions
